project_summary: Real-time hospital asset tracking with indoor location

components.name: BLE beacon ingestion
components.description: Ingestion of Bluetooth Low Energy beacon signals from gateways, trilateration of asset positions and deduplication of noisy readings.

components.name: Indoor map dashboard
components.description: Floor plan viewer showing live positions of wheelchairs, infusion pumps and other equipment, with search and history playback.

components.name: Geofencing alerts
components.description: Alerts when equipment leaves an authorised zone or stays idle too long, delivered by email and to the nursing station screen.

components.name: HIPAA audit trail and encryption
components.description: Encryption at rest and in transit, access audit trail, and data retention policies required for HIPAA compliance.
